Where the money leaks

THE MONEY IS MADE IN THE FOLLOW-UP.

Most good opportunities aren't deliberately ignored. You're busy. You mean to chase the quote later. You don't want to feel pushy. Or silence gets interpreted as, “they've gone with someone cheaper.”

But not getting a reply doesn't necessarily mean a no.

You get busy.The follow-up you meant to send Thursday becomes Monday... then gets forgotten.
You don't want to chase.Following up personally can feel awkward, especially once you've already sent the price.
You assume price lost it.But they may not have chosen the cheaper quote at all. They may simply have gone with the business that stayed in touch, looked organised and made the next step easy.

TradeOS isn't about creating more admin. It's about removing the parts of the sales process that currently rely on memory and spare time.

Without a system

With TradeOS

More than software

We're not just building the system. We want to help you build a better business.

Every two weeks, the founding group will get together with me for a live business-growth session. Part of that is about TradeOS... what's working, what's awkward and what we should improve next. But the rest is about whatever could help your business win more work, keep more of it and make more from the customers you already have.

Bring whatever you're trying to solve.

Need more enquiries? We can look at Facebook, local groups, social media, flyers, paid ads and other ways of generating leads.
Quotes aren't converting? We can look at the sales conversation, how you present the quote and what happens afterwards.
Want to make more from each customer? We can look at additional services, recurring income and other opportunities already sitting inside the business.
Not sure how to present the business? Bring your website, Facebook page, advert, flyer or idea and we'll work through it together.

Sales. Marketing. Lead generation. Follow-up. Pricing. Positioning. Systems. Customer journeys. If it can help you build a stronger local trade business, it's fair game.

And the founding group will help shape what comes next.

The questions and problems that keep coming up in these sessions will help us build a growing TradeOS training area with practical guides and resources based on what real trade businesses actually want help with... rather than us guessing what you should learn.
